authNote: Every operation's OpenAPI doc says 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]' — that is WRONG for the personal-access API key this project uses. Empirically confirmed working: 'Authorization: token <key>'. Bearer returns HTTP 400 {"code":200058,"message":"User in token does not exist."}. See specs/rest/index.json.

operations.summary: Batch create plan tasks for leads
operations.description: Creates AI plan tasks for multiple leads. Each lead must already be in the Sales Agent working pool. Returns succeeded and failed lead IDs. Max 100 leads per request.

operations.summary: Get plan tasks by lead ID
operations.description: Retrieves AI tasks associated with a lead. Tasks are returned in V2 format with human-friendly status and type names.

operations.summary: Send SMS to agent via AI number
operations.description: Sends an SMS message to the current logged-in agent using the Sales Agent's AI virtual number as the sender.

operations.summary: Get Sales Agent lead mute status
operations.description: Returns the mute status of the AI assistant for the specified lead.
Returns the Sales Agent settings configured for the current caller.
Update the Sales Agent settings for the current user. Sales Agent creation must be completed in CRM. This API only supports updating existing settings.

operations.summary: Get Sales Agent by lead ID
operations.description: Retrieves the Sales Agent (AI Assistant) configuration associated with the specified lead.
Retrieves the Sales Agent (AI Assistant) configuration for the current logged-in user. Returns detailed information including assistant profile, virtual contact info, and quota settings.

operations.summary: Get current user's Sales Agent quota
operations.description: Retrieves AI quota information for the current logged-in user, including total quota, used quota, remaining quota, and borrow status.

operations.summary: Check if lead is a working lead
operations.description: Checks whether a lead is currently in the Sales Agent's AI working pool. Returns true if the lead is actively being followed up, false otherwise.
Mutes the AI assistant for the specified lead to stop further automated follow-ups. Verifies success by checking mute status after operation.

Retrieves a paginated list of leads currently being followed up by AI Sales Agent. Supports filtering by AI stage (HIGH_PRIORITY, AI_PROSPECTING, AI_MONITORING). Returns lead basic info with AI stage, task counts, and timestamps.

parameters.name: aiStage
parameters.description: AI follow-up stage filter (HIGH_PRIORITY, AI_PROSPECTING, AI_MONITORING)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start index of the responded leads

operations.summary: Batch add leads to Sales Agent working pool
operations.description: Adds multiple leads to the AI Sales Agent working pool. Optionally creates plan tasks for each successfully added lead. Returns succeeded and failed lead IDs. Max 100 leads per request.
